info.name: Smart Campaign Composer
info.description: Local API regression checks for implemented slices 1 and 2. Uses synthetic briefs and aggregate previews only. Each full run creates one persistent draft; no delete endpoint exists.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost):8080$/.test(target)) throw new Error("This collection permits only the local Compose API on port 8080");

pm.test("Stored draft", () => { pm.expect(String(data.id)).to.eql(pm.variables.get("campaignId")); pm.expect(data.brief).to.eql("Postman synthetic campaign"); pm.expect(data.channels).to.deep.eql(["sms","email"]); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql("draft"); pm.expect(data.segment).to.eql(null); });

for(const frame of frames){const e=frame.data;if(frame.kind==="attempt"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt+1);attempt=e.attempt;parts={};}else if(frame.kind==="delta"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt);pm.expect(["sms","email"]).to.include(e.channel);pm.expect(e.channel==="sms"?["body"]:["subject","body"]).to.include(e.field);const key=e.channel+"."+e.field;parts[key]=(parts[key]||"")+e.text;deltas++;}else if(frame.kind==="validated"){last=e;finals++;}else throw new Error("Stream failed: "+frame.kind);}

pm.test("Complete selected channels match streamed text",()=>{pm.expect(last.messages).to.have.all.keys("sms","email");pm.expect(last.messages.sms).to.have.all.keys("body");pm.expect(last.messages.email).to.have.all.keys("subject","body");for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages))for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields))pm.expect(text).to.eql(parts[ch+"."+field]);});

pm.test("Rendered worst-case limits and allowed placeholders",()=>{for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages)){const b=last.audience.by_channel[ch];for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields)){pm.expect(text.trim()).not.to.eql("");const rendered=text.replace(/\{\{(first_name|city)\}\}/g,(_,name)=>"x".repeat(b.count===0?(name==="first_name"?80:120):b[name==="first_name"?"max_first_name_runes":"max_city_runes"]));pm.expect(rendered).not.to.match(/[{}]/);pm.expect(Array.from(rendered).length).to.be.at.most(ch==="sms"?160:field==="subject"?80:2000);}}});

for(const frame of frames){const e=frame.data;if(frame.kind==="attempt"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt+1);attempt=e.attempt;parts={};}else if(frame.kind==="delta"){pm.expect(e.attempt).to.eql(attempt);pm.expect(["sms","email"]).to.include(e.channel);pm.expect(e.channel==="sms"?["body"]:["subject","body"]).to.include(e.field);const key=e.channel+"."+e.field;parts[key]=(parts[key]||"")+e.text;deltas++;}else if(frame.kind==="validated"){last=e;finals++;}else throw new Error("Stream failed: "+frame.kind);}

pm.test("Complete selected channels match streamed text",()=>{pm.expect(last.messages).to.have.all.keys("sms","email");pm.expect(last.messages.sms).to.have.all.keys("body");pm.expect(last.messages.email).to.have.all.keys("subject","body");for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages))for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields))pm.expect(text).to.eql(parts[ch+"."+field]);});

pm.test("Rendered worst-case limits and allowed placeholders",()=>{for(const [ch,fields] of Object.entries(last.messages)){const b=last.audience.by_channel[ch];for(const [field,text] of Object.entries(fields)){pm.expect(text.trim()).not.to.eql("");const rendered=text.replace(/\{\{(first_name|city)\}\}/g,(_,name)=>"x".repeat(b.count===0?(name==="first_name"?80:120):b[name==="first_name"?"max_first_name_runes":"max_city_runes"]));pm.expect(rendered).not.to.match(/[{}]/);pm.expect(Array.from(rendered).length).to.be.at.most(ch==="sms"?160:field==="subject"?80:2000);}}});

pm.test("Still draft with same segment and no saved messages",()=>{const c=pm.response.json();pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("draft");pm.expect(c.segment).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("messageSourceSegment")));pm.expect(c).not.to.have.property("messages");});
